panels.description: COLORADO PILOT — DAY. Inspectors examine rejected feedstock, residual solids, and an active emissions monitor before permitting restart. Keep machinery and wet floor visible. Leave upper-left clear.
An inspector checks the constructed-wetland inlet gauge while a technician records flow. The gauge is below but near its finite limit. Leave upper third clear.

The monitoring wall shows a dated measurable pilot result, active grid demand, and limited throughput. Use a concrete gauge or survey readout without unapproved numerical values. Leave upper-right clear.
Selected feedstock moves through the process while rejected material remains separate. The facility continues under inspection conditions. Keep silent.

items.text: Finite. We stay below the line.
